category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
literal_source_claim_en: The recurrence relation for binomial coefficients.
canonical_statement: For natural numbers m and n satisfying m >= n >= 1, the binomial coefficient C(m,n) equals C(m-1,n) plus C(m-1,n-1).
canonical_claim: The DLMF 26.3.5 predecessor recurrence for ordinary natural binomial coefficients, with ordered binders m and n, hypotheses n <= m and 1 <= n, and the source's displayed summand order.
statement_blocker: The exact source-shaped Lean target is self-tested. Dependency-ordered master acceptance is pending, and historical Pascal-source fidelity, complete proof and correction mapping, and independent H0 review remain open without invalidating the conservative H1 statement selection.
target_decision: select the only preserved formula-level published lead, DLMF 26.3.5, with its m >= n >= 1 domain; exclude the broader zero-extended all-natural successor recurrence from the canonical root and admit only checked domain-preserving transports
domain_and_universes: The ordered row and column binders m and n range over Nat; the proposition has no universe or typeclass parameters. Nat.choose supplies natural-valued zero-extended coefficients, while the canonical implications claim the recurrence only on n <= m and 1 <= n.
conclusion: Nat.choose m n = Nat.choose (m - 1) n + Nat.choose (m - 1) (n - 1)
degenerate_case_status: Positive diagonals, including (1,1), are included. Column zero is excluded by 1 <= n and has a checked false-formula counter-boundary. Out-of-range columns are excluded by n <= m; a checked example shows why the unrestricted successor recurrence is broader.
